question: Which state has been reinstated as a tiger state after 33 years following confirmation of a tiger in Ratanmahal Sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Gujarat has been reinstated as a tiger state after 33 years following confirmation of a tiger in Ratanmahal Sanctuary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Gujarat regained its tiger state status after three decades based on confirmation of a tiger in Ratanmahal Sanctuary located in Dahod district.**
 
• **The decision was taken by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA), the apex body for tiger conservation in India.**
 
• **The confirmed tiger presence has led to Gujarat’s inclusion in the All India Tiger Estimation 2026.**
 
• **Modern techniques such as camera traps and stripe recognition software were used to identify the tiger.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• National Tiger Conservation Authority__

 __
 
• NTCA is a statutory body under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
 
• It oversees tiger conservation efforts, monitoring, and policy implementation across India.
 
• The authority validates tiger presence and approves conservation-related decisions.
 
 
 
• Ratanmahal Sanctuary__
 __
 
• Ratanmahal Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the Dahod district of Gujarat.
 
• Following the confirmed tiger presence, there is potential consideration to declare it a Tiger Reserve.
 
• Such a declaration would strengthen legal protection and conservation funding.
 
 
 
• All India Tiger Estimation 2026__
 __
 
• The All India Tiger Estimation is one of the world’s largest wildlife population surveys.
 
• The 2026 cycle recently commenced in Indore.
 
• It uses scientific tools like camera traps and stripe pattern recognition to estimate tiger populations.
 
 
 
• Camera Trap and Stripe Recognition__
 
 
• Camera traps capture images of wildlife in their natural habitats without disturbance.
 
• Stripe recognition software identifies individual tigers based on unique stripe patterns.
 
• These methods ensure accurate population monitoring and long-term conservation planning.
